title: Dungeon Fighter II Tournament
description: Dungeon Fighter II Tournament — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Hunt

Quest Description: Slay 15 Ice Orok Runts and 15 Toxic Mutant Pincers in lower Widow's Nest

Quest Reward: 4125 Gold

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

This quest was only offered after reaching level 33.

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill 15 Ice Orok Runts and 15 Toxic Mutant Pincers in the dungeons off of lower Widower's Nest and Return to the Townston Commander in Townston.

Offer:

We have received news that the Widow Maker is holding a Dungeon Fighter II tournament for the Ice Oroks and Toxic Mutants in Widower's Nest. It is rumored that the winner of the tournament will be promoted and will be the Widow Maker's new Leader in the dungeon. The Widow Maker is known for her ruthless recruiting and her uncanny ability to judge personality, so it is a given that whomever she chooses will be a huge threat to Dungeon Runners across the Widower's Nest.

The first stage of the tournament is being held between Ice Orok Runts and Toxic Mutant Pincers. These creatures are considered long shots to win the Dungeon Fighter II tournament, but that doesn't mean we should take them lightly. Just think what would happen if they were allowed to set the handicap level and won in a huge upset? We can't let that happen!

Find and slay the Ice Orok Runts and Toxic Mutant Pincers and when you have done that you can return to me, the Townston Commander, here in Townston.

Turn-in:

Finished with them, I see. Glad to hear it! I did notice that you were using that one combo a lot, and that can really tick off other players, so keep it up!

Objectives:

  • Slain Ice Orok Runts
  • Slain Toxic Mutant Pincers

Level range: 33–40
